response.description: You can now use Microsoft Defender security assessments for Azure Database for PostgreSQL to continuously evaluate your database security posture and identify potential vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. This feature helps you strengthen your security baseline, prioritize remediation based on risk, and align with best practices and compliance requirements. You can proactively protect your PostgreSQL workloads with integrated insights directly in Microsoft Defender for Cloud.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Microsoft Defender security assessments for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
